purpose: Paired complete-trip trajectory and command diagnosis of the inherited vs final failed orbital-joint controller. No training, selection, interventions or reliability qualification.
scope: Recorded actions replayed once per completed trip through frozen physics; pure arithmetic analysis only

eventConvention: Positive raw pitch crossing sampled after each original physical step; target crossing uses physical altitude y-8. Event decision at its timestamp if present, otherwise preceding; applied-before decision also retained. No synthetic endpoint decision.
publicEventProjection: Physical events and timing are included here. Complete decisions and commands applied before each event remain in the full archived summary.json.
averagingConvention: Requested commands held over original decision intervals; realized actuator values post-step over original physical intervals. Exact time overlaps with interval endpoints.
holdConvention: Strict physical predicate evaluated after every step regardless of phase; longest contiguous time is independent of phase-gated simulator orbitHold. Independent rolling reward sums direct overlaps in a fixed 3-second denominator.
limitations: Six development cases per model, with no held-out reliability inference or controller selection.
Frozen snapshot attests these new probes and their replay, not all historical dependencies of preceding training.
Decoded versus presented arithmetic comparisons change no action or state and do not isolate causal effects.
Requested pitch-gimbal and pitch-RCS commands have opposite direct torque signs, and servo state may differ from commands.
